title: Fastest on Land, Tallest on Earth
subtitle: 考点：动植物事实 / weigh / up to
passage: The cheetah is the fastest animal on land. It can run more than 100 kilometres per hour, but only for a short time. A cheetah has long legs and a small head, so it can start very quickly. It lives mainly in Africa and hunts small animals like deer.

The redwood is one of the tallest trees in the world. Some redwoods are over 100 metres tall, and they grow in the west of the United States. They can live for thousands of years. Redwoods like wet air from the ocean, so they grow near the coast.

People are surprised by how big redwoods are. A tall redwood can weigh many tons. Students who visit the redwood forest often say that they feel tiny next to the trees. Scientists say we should protect these giants, because they are home to many birds and small animals.
